{"lean_source":"import Std

-- BEGIN VERISLOP REGISTRY
-- Generated by `verislop formalize`. Typed obligation metadata: an index, never evidence.
namespace VeriSlop.Registry

structure SourceRef where
  documentRef : String
  documentHash : String
  startByte : Nat
  endByte : Nat
  origin : String
  interpretation : String

structure Dependency where
  id : String
  relation : String

structure Entry where
  id : String
  revision : Nat
  kind : String
  role : String
  statement : String
  required : Bool
  sourceRefs : List SourceRef
  scope : List String
  dependencies : List Dependency
  acceptanceCriteria : List String
  bindings : List String

def «D1» : Entry := {
  id := "D1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "entity",
  role := "declaration",
  statement := "The input is a JSON object with integer fields n, m, a, b; the output is a JSON-serializable integer scalar.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 125, endByte := 175, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "JSON-compatible interface" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 372, endByte := 456, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Named integer input fields" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 729, endByte := 802, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "JSON-serializable return value" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 803, endByte := 868, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Preserve the specified object input and scalar output structure" }],
  scope := ["input and output"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Input fields represent n, m, a and b.", "Output is the integer sum itself, without an additional wrapper."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.Input", "VeriSlopAST.solve"] }

def «A1» : Entry := {
  id := "A1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "precondition",
  role := "assumption",
  statement := "Supplied inputs satisfy the schema: integer n with 0<=n<=500, positive integer m, and arbitrary signed integers a and b, including magnitudes of 10^30.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 269, endByte := 326, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Supplier guarantees schema and bounds" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 372, endByte := 456, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Specified numeric domain" }],
  scope := ["supplied inputs"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D1", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Each supplied input has the stated integer fields and satisfies 0<=n<=500 and m>0.", "No additional restriction is imposed on the sign or magnitude of a and b."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.valid_input"] }

def «O1» : Entry := {
  id := "O1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "For every valid input, return exactly the sum over i=0 through n-1 of floor((a*i+b)/m), where floor rounds toward negative infinity; return zero when n=0.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 457, endByte := 507, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Exact floor-sum formula and index range" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 508, endByte := 561, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Signed floor semantics" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 562, endByte := 580, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Empty sum" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 803, endByte := 868, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Specified ordering" }],
  scope := ["all inputs satisfying A1"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D1", relation := "uses_definition" }, { id := "A1", relation := "assumes" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["The returned integer equals the mathematical sum for every valid input.", "Negative quotients are rounded toward negative infinity rather than truncated toward zero.", "For n=0 the returned integer is 0.", "Terms correspond to indices 0,1,...,n-1 in the specified order."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.solve_contract"] }

def «O2» : Entry := {
  id := "O2",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Provide a single pure deterministic Python 3 function solve(data) in solution.py.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 67, endByte := 124, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Required file and single function interface" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 604, endByte := 680, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Purity, determinism and Python 3 implementation" }],
  scope := ["implementation and function invocations"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["solution.py exposes the single requested solve(data) function.", "Repeated calls with equal inputs return equal results.", "The function has no observable side effects."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.solve_contract"] }

def «O3» : Entry := {
  id := "O3",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "The public examples return -4 for {a:-2,b:1,m:3,n:4} and 0 for {a:100,b:-99,m:7,n:0}; the same specified behavior applies to held-out valid inputs.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 870, endByte := 1052, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Public example results and additional held-out cases" }],
  scope := ["public examples and held-out valid inputs"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "O1", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["solve({\"a\":-2,\"b\":1,\"m\":3,\"n\":4}) returns -4.", "solve({\"a\":100,\"b\":-99,\"m\":7,\"n\":0}) returns 0.", "Implementation satisfies the formula beyond the public examples."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.public_examples"] }

def «S1» : Entry := {
  id := "S1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "safety_property",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Use only the Python 3 standard library, perform no external I/O, and do not read benchmark files.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 176, endByte := 211, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Standard-library restriction" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 212, endByte := 268, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "External I/O and benchmark access prohibitions" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 681, endByte := 728, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Repeated library and I/O restrictions" }],
  scope := ["implementation and execution"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["No dependency outside the Python 3 standard library is used.", "Execution performs no external input or output.", "Benchmark files are never read."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.solve_contract"] }

def «S2» : Entry := {
  id := "S2",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "safety_property",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Compute the result without floating-point arithmetic.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 581, endByte := 602, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Floating-point prohibition" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 457, endByte := 507, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Exact result requirement" }],
  scope := ["numeric computation"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["No floating-point conversion or arithmetic is used to evaluate the sum or its terms.", "Large signed integer inputs retain exact arithmetic semantics."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.solve_contract"] }

def «N1» : Entry := {
  id := "N1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "explicit_non_goal",
  role := "exclusion",
  statement := "Behavior for malformed inputs is outside the required scope.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 327, endByte := 371, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Explicit malformed-input exclusion" }],
  scope := ["inputs violating the specified schema or bounds"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["No validation or result behavior is required for malformed inputs."],
  bindings := [] }

def «valid_input_witness» : Entry := {
  id := "valid_input_witness",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "non_vacuity",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Non-vacuity: Input n=0, m=1, a=0, b=0 satisfies the schema bounds. (witnesses A1)",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 269, endByte := 326, origin := "inferred", interpretation := "derived by registered rule verislop.non-vacuity/0.1 from assumption A1" }, { documentRef := "tasks/A23/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:4210b881ec112b3ceaf86658d8a931f6d4dea05689a85d3e7e72aed9da3911dd", startByte := 372, endByte := 456, origin := "inferred", interpretation := "derived by registered rule verislop.non-vacuity/0.1 from assumption A1" }],
  scope := ["supplied inputs"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "A1", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Prove the existential theorem with concrete witnesses extractable by bounded kernel head-normalisation."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.valid_input_nonempty"] }

def entries : List Entry := [«D1», «A1», «O1», «O2», «O3», «S1», «S2», «N1», «valid_input_witness»]

end VeriSlop.Registry
-- END VERISLOP REGISTRY

namespace VeriSlopAST
structure «Input» where
  «n» : _root_.Int
  «m» : _root_.Int
  «a» : _root_.Int
  «b» : _root_.Int
def «solve» («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input») : _root_.Int := (_root_.List.sum (@_root_.List.map _root_.Nat _root_.Int (fun («_v1» : _root_.Nat) => (_root_.Int.fdiv (_root_.Int.add (_root_.Int.mul (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«a» «_v0») (_root_.Int.ofNat «_v1»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«b» «_v0»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«m» «_v0»))) (_root_.List.range (_root_.Int.toNat (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0»)))))
theorem «_vs_body_solve» : (∀ («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input»), ((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«solve» «_v0») = (_root_.List.sum (@_root_.List.map _root_.Nat _root_.Int (fun («_v1» : _root_.Nat) => (_root_.Int.fdiv (_root_.Int.add (_root_.Int.mul (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«a» «_v0») (_root_.Int.ofNat «_v1»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«b» «_v0»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«m» «_v0»))) (_root_.List.range (_root_.Int.toNat (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0»))))))) := by intros; rfl
@[reducible] def «valid_input» («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input») : Prop := (((_root_.Int.ofNat 0) ≤ (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0»)) ∧ (((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0») ≤ (_root_.Int.ofNat 500)) ∧ ((_root_.Int.ofNat 0) < (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«m» «_v0»))))
theorem «_vs_predicate_valid_input» («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input») : ((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«valid_input» «_v0») ↔ (((_root_.Int.ofNat 0) ≤ (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0»)) ∧ (((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0») ≤ (_root_.Int.ofNat 500)) ∧ ((_root_.Int.ofNat 0) < (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«m» «_v0»))))) := by rfl
theorem «public_examples» : (((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«solve» (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«mk» (_root_.Int.ofNat 4) (_root_.Int.ofNat 3) (_root_.Int.negSucc 1) (_root_.Int.ofNat 1))) = (_root_.Int.negSucc 3)) ∧ (((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«solve» (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«mk» (_root_.Int.ofNat 0) (_root_.Int.ofNat 7) (_root_.Int.ofNat 100) (_root_.Int.negSucc 98))) = (_root_.Int.ofNat 0)) ∧ (∀ («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input»), ((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«solve» «_v0») = (_root_.List.sum (@_root_.List.map _root_.Nat _root_.Int (fun («_v1» : _root_.Nat) => (_root_.Int.fdiv (_root_.Int.add (_root_.Int.mul (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«a» «_v0») (_root_.Int.ofNat «_v1»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«b» «_v0»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«m» «_v0»))) (_root_.List.range (_root_.Int.toNat (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0»))))))))) := by refine ⟨by decide, by decide, ?_⟩; intro x; rfl
theorem «solve_contract» : (∀ («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input»), ((_root_.VeriSlopAST.«solve» «_v0») = (_root_.List.sum (@_root_.List.map _root_.Nat _root_.Int (fun («_v1» : _root_.Nat) => (_root_.Int.fdiv (_root_.Int.add (_root_.Int.mul (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«a» «_v0») (_root_.Int.ofNat «_v1»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«b» «_v0»)) (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«m» «_v0»))) (_root_.List.range (_root_.Int.toNat (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input».«n» «_v0»))))))) := by intro x; rfl
theorem «valid_input_nonempty» : (∃ («_v0» : _root_.VeriSlopAST.«Input»), (_root_.VeriSlopAST.«valid_input» «_v0»)) := by refine ⟨{ «n» := 0, «m» := 1, «a» := 0, «b» := 0 : VeriSlopAST.Input }, ?_⟩; decide
end VeriSlopAST

"}
